preservation: Publisher API translation text, Arabic source, numbering, whitespace, footnote markers and notes are kept verbatim. The existing SALAH Arabic Quran remains its own unchanged edition.
attribution: The reader must display the translator or institution, QuranEnc.com, source link and edition version. Retain notes and source metadata when sharing or exporting.
maintenance: Check the publisher catalogue and browse pages when updating the pinned manifest. Newly changed bytes must be reviewed and re-pinned before use; previously verified offline copies remain tied to their edition version.
formatDifference: The publisher's SQLite and API exports differ in number prefixes, whitespace and some notes. Their ayah mappings were verified independently. No claim is made that those two exports are byte-identical; SALAH uses the documented API response without normalizing its text.
download: Meaning translations are loaded individually from the documented public QuranEnc API. Complete corpora are not bundled into the native app archive.
boundaries: Interface language never automatically changes the selected Quran translation.
No machine translation or automatic transliteration of scripture.
The Uzbek editions verified here are Cyrillic; the Uzbek interface uses Latin script.
Arabic Quran original is not a translated edition. Public Tafsir entry points remain removed.
Religious notification excerpts retain their reviewed source edition until separately verified native-language excerpts are prepared.
